name: Battery link: the Osa 21 and the PU-12M in one battery
description: The raid of pu12m_battery.json on a deployed Osa-AK battery, with the player's choice of vehicle: the Osa 21 (its crew, or its commander) or the PU-12M (the battery commander, the plotter, the post's crew). The post gives targets by voice on the battery net; 21 hears them as the PU-12's; its commander's reports go onto the post's IT boards. Launchers 22-24 are the abstract crews of battery_fire.hpp.
